text: A mounted warrior, likely male, appears aged mid-30s to 50s with a robust build. Skin tone is dark, face angular with sharp features. Hair is short, dark, and spiky. Costume: armored cuirass, chainmail sleeves, ornate shield with black-and-white emblem, golden-brown saddlecloth. He holds a scythe-like weapon aloft in right hand, left hand grips shield. Pose: riding forward on a black horse through fiery terrain. Background shows smoke, birds, and glowing lava flows.
